experimentar.mios.vacio: You have not saved any scenarios yet.
experimentar.mios.invalidos.uno: {n} saved one can no longer be read and is hidden.
experimentar.mios.invalidos.otros: {n} saved ones can no longer be read and are hidden.
experimentar.escenarios.ayuda: A scenario keeps options, species and world objects. The seed is chosen when starting. Built-in ones cannot be changed: duplicate them to edit.
experimentar.base.ayuda: Changing the base sets the values the new base fixes; species, objects and changes to parameters the base does not fix are kept.
experimentar.avanzado.buscar.placeholder: Search a parameter by name or variable
experimentar.avanzado.cambiado.ayuda: Different from the scenario base value
experimentar.avanzado.aBaseDe: Set {nombre} back to the base value ({valor})
experimentar.avanzado.baseGrupo: Set the whole «{grupo}» group back to the base
experimentar.avanzado.error.rango: Beyond what the engine accepts: it must be between {min} and {max}.
experimentar.avanzado.error.entero: It must be a whole number.
experimentar.avanzado.aviso.inusual: Unusual value (the usual range is {min} to {max}). It is accepted anyway.
experimentar.avanzado.aviso.saturado: The engine cannot store a value beyond its limit: {v} is used.
experimentar.ajustesF1.ayuda: Puts the F1 league costs, physics, 9237×6928 toroidal field, vegetable economy and mutations off into the draft. Everything else, species and objects stay.
experimentar.objetos.ayuda: Obstacles and teleporters are placed at random with the seed when the simulation is created. Afterwards you can edit them live with the World button in Observe.
experimentar.pendientes.requiereNueva: Some changes need a new simulation: «Apply to current» only sends the ones that apply live.
experimentar.sinCorrida: No simulation is running: the changes are used when a new one starts.
experimentar.sinEscenario: The running simulation did not come from a scenario (it was loaded from a file): the changes are used when a new one starts.
experimentar.especies.ninguna: No species: the world starts empty.
experimentar.especie.fuente.bestiario: A bot from the library (by name)
experimentar.especie.sinIndice: The library bot list could not be read.
experimentar.especie.noEncontrado: There is no bot named «{bot}» in the library.
experimentar.especie.adnSinGen: The DNA has no genes: each gene starts with cond or start.
experimentar.semilla.ayuda: Same scenario and same seed = same simulation.
experimentar.nuevaSim.ayuda: Uses the whole draft, including changes not applied, and opens Observe.
experimentar.borrar.pregunta: Delete the scenario «{nombre}»? The draft stays open until you pick another one.
experimentar.guardar.reemplazar: Replace «{nombre}» (otherwise it is saved as a new one)
experimentar.aviso.aplicado.uno: {n} change applied at cycle {ciclo} and recorded in the run.
experimentar.aviso.aplicado.otros: {n} changes applied at cycle {ciclo} and recorded in the run.
experimentar.aviso.aplicadoParcial.uno: {n} change applied at cycle {ciclo}. The rest needs a new simulation.
experimentar.aviso.aplicadoParcial.otros: {n} changes applied at cycle {ciclo}. The rest needs a new simulation.
experimentar.aviso.duplicado: Copy «{nombre}» created: it can now be edited and saved.
experimentar.aviso.importadoRenombrado: Scenario «{nombre}» imported with the identifier «{id}» because the identifier it came with was already in use.
experimentar.aviso.noEncontrado: The scenario «{id}» does not exist: it may have been deleted.
experimentar.aviso.ajustesF1: F1 settings loaded into the draft: apply them with «Apply to current» (the live ones) or with a new simulation.
experimentar.aviso.base: Base changed to «{base}»: species and objects are kept.
experimentar.error.almacen.version-vieja: Another tab opened the data with a newer version of the app: reload this page to keep saving.
experimentar.error.almacen.sin-indexeddb: This browser does not allow saving data (IndexedDB blocked or private mode): your scenarios cannot be saved.
experimentar.error.cuota: There is no space left to save data in this browser.
experimentar.error.sinAdn: The DNA of «{bot}» was not found: remove it or add it again.
experimentar.error.semilla: The seed must be a whole number between 1 and 2147483646.
experimentar.error.almacenBloqueado: Another tab with an older version of the app is preventing access to saved data: close or reload it.
experimentar.error.fabricaInexistente: That built-in scenario does not exist ({msg}).
experimentar.error.bestiario: Could not read the list of library bots ({msg}).
experimentar.error.bestiarioBot: Could not read the DNA of a library bot ({msg}).
experimentar.validacion.json: The file is not valid JSON ({detalle}).
experimentar.validacion.no-objeto: The file does not contain a scenario.
experimentar.validacion.id: Invalid identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
experimentar.validacion.id-reservado: The identifier «{detalle}» belongs to a built-in scenario.
experimentar.validacion.descripcion: The description is not valid text.
experimentar.validacion.etiquetas: Tags must be a list of texts.
experimentar.validacion.opciones: The options do not have the expected format ({ruta}).
experimentar.validacion.clave-derivada: Parameter that cannot be set (it derives from others): {ruta}.
experimentar.validacion.especie-cantidad: The quantity must be a whole number between 1 and 10000 ({ruta}).
experimentar.validacion.especie-vegetal: It must say whether it is a vegetable ({ruta}).
experimentar.validacion.especie-energia: The starting energy must be a whole number between 0 and 32000 ({ruta}).
experimentar.validacion.especie-hash-adn: The DNA does not match its fingerprint ({ruta}).
experimentar.validacion.objetos: The world objects do not have the expected format ({ruta}).
experimentar.avanzado.ayudaGrupo: Open this parameter group in the manual
